structure: tympanic annulus (tympanum), diameter relative to eye diameter (TD/ED)
measurement: TD 64.5% of ED, holotype KU 343230 (adult male)
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; percentage printed in the Description of the holotype. Eye-size passage (Materials and methods > Specimen collection and morphological measurement, as printed, pieces joined): '(4) horizontal eye diameter (ED)' and '(10) horizontal tympanum diameter (TD)', taken 'with a Mituyo digital caliper (precision 0.01 mm)' and rounded to 0.1 mm; the unit is mm; ED is a defined diameter. Preservation as printed: 'Specimens were euthanised using Tricaine, fixed in ~ 10% formalin (buffered with sodium phosphate to ~ 7.0 pH) for 24 hours and then stored in 70% ethanol for long-term preservation.'
conditions: One specimen. Holotype as printed: 'KU 343230 (field number CRH 1110), an adult male', Vohidrazana Forest near Andasibe, about 1150 m, 5 January 2016. Paratypes: the text prints no total; it lists eight specimens by individual labels (reader count): adult males KU 343229 (CRH 1108), UADBA-CRH 1061, UADBA-CRH 1626 and adult females UADBA-CRH 472, KU 343218, UADBA-CRH 1819, KU 347328, KU 347329. Table 2 holds the holotype and only five paratypes (KU 343229, KU 343218, UADBA CRH1061, KU 347328, KU 347329; Sex row M M M M F F), so it prints KU 343218 as M where the Paratypes text gives 'adult female'. The same sentence gives the tympanic annulus as distinct, round and small, the supratympanic fold indistinct and irregular and the tympanic membrane lighter than ground colouration. Text and table differ slightly: the holotype description prints TD 64.5% of ED, while the Table 2 holotype cells TD 2.5 and ED 3.8 give 65.8% (my arithmetic); not reconciled in the paper. The Table 2 TD cell (2.5 mm) is filed as a separate record: an absolute diameter, a different quantity from this ratio. The only Diagnosis tympanum clause is subgenus-level ('tympanum is the same size in male and female', for Laurentomantis). Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
where: Results > Gephyromantis marokoroko sp. nov. > Description of the holotype (whole sentence); no Class, Order or Family heading is printed (the XML carries an unheaded classification Animalia, Anura, Mantellidae)
